svg.text: W4 · Network, PoE and antenna wiring
Everything is copper Ethernet + PoE inside the box. Plant network enters on C4 through G4.
ALT DC (dashed): only if SPL1 browns out;
then C3 unplugged, 16 AWG RD/BK, inline 4 A fuse
A1-A4: RG316 SMA-M → bulkhead, inside the box
A5-A8: field coax to 5 dBi panel antennas at the door (LMR-195/240, keep ≤ 20 ft)
ANT5-8 unused: terminate if reader requires
Check GPI V range in the full
RFID PANEL BOX · RPB-001 · WIRING DIAGRAM
Gielow Pickles · G5 Croswell · one box per dock door
plant switch → G4 → SW1 → SPL1 → U1 · SW1 → K1 · U1 → 4 antennas
Units: inches, AWG. Wire numbers are per potential: the same number on both ends and every jumper of one net. Ref RPB-001 rev 8 drawing + illustrated schematic.
